items.title: Free Layered Petal Shell DXF Panel for Laser Cut Doors
items.description: Overlapping teardrop and shell-shaped petals stack into a dense, almost blooming cluster at the panel's center, framed by an angular stained-glass style border. The rounded organic petal shapes contrast with the sharper triangular border segments, giving the piece a layered sense of depth.
